collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: Friends planned a canoe trip to a nearby islet, but an experienced fisher sees signs of a coming storm.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Friends planned a canoe trip to a nearby islet, but (name1), an experienced fisher, sees signs of a coming storm and must decide whether to speak up.

choices.label: Go Along to Watch the Weather.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The trip is postponed, and the storm arrives that afternoon.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The storm passes far away, and the group is disappointed, but the fisher stands by the warning.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The friends learn to read the clouds themselves.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The friends disagree with the reading, but they choose caution.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The group explores the nearby shore and enjoys the day.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The shorter trip feels dull, but everyone is safe.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The fisher turns the canoes back at the first sign of trouble.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The weather holds, and the fisher enjoys the trip as much as anyone.
